results.name: no model-end handler can inject or suspend another turn
no hidden follow-up, completion gate, or text-to-tool recovery
no automatic task classifier or forced planning
runtime exposes only user input and goal tools, with no retired conversation controls
agent_end is not a UI terminal, including non-retry endings
native settled emits exactly one terminal UI event
native retry can recover without a premature failure or stale error
terminal provider error remains visible only at settled
tool error remains a tool error, not an invented run failure
successive steer requests neither cancel a run nor replace Pi queues
runtime observer does not turn business evidence into a model error
legacy hidden directives are removed without erasing real user answers/history
legacy Todo and Plan tool records remain readable history without reviving their tools
tool wait, native retry and user input are not mislabeled as thinking
